prayer.english: Prayer (Salah) is one of the 5 pillars of Islam. It is obligatory to pray 5 times daily: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
prayer.luganda: Okusiima (Salah) kimu ku bintu 5 eby'omuwendo mu Siraamu. Kisaana okusiima emirundi 5 buli lunaku: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, ne Isha.

fasting.english: Fasting in Ramadan is obligatory for all adult Muslims. It teaches self-control, patience, and empathy for the poor.
fasting.luganda: Okusiiba mu Ramadan kya buli Musiraamu omukulu. Kyigiriza okwekema, okugumiikiriza, n'okusaasira abavu.

zakat.english: Zakat is 2.5% of your savings given to the poor annually. It purifies wealth and helps redistribute resources.
zakat.luganda: Zakat ye 2.5% ku by'ofunye obiwadde abavu buli mwaka. Ekuza obugagga n'eyamba okugabana eby'obugagga.

hajj.english: Hajj is pilgrimage to Mecca, obligatory once in lifetime for those who are able. It occurs in Dhul-Hijjah.
hajj.luganda: Hajj ye kugenda e Mecca, kya buli muntu asobola omulundi gumu mu bulamu. Kukolebwa mu mwezi gwa Dhul-Hijjah.

tawheed.english: Tawheed is the belief in the Oneness of Allah. It is the foundation of Islamic faith.
tawheed.luganda: Tawheed ye kukkiriza mu bumu bwa Allah. Ye nsibo y'okukkiriza kw'Obusiraamu.

patience.english: Patience (Sabr) is highly rewarded in Islam. Allah is with those who are patient.
patience.luganda: Okugumiikiriza (Sabr) kuli mukisa munene mu Siraamu. Allah ali n'abo abagumiikiriza.

charity.english: Charity (Sadaqah) is voluntary giving beyond Zakat. Even a smile is charity.
charity.luganda: Ekisa (Sadaqah) kwe kuwa okusinga Zakat. N'okuseka kye kisa.

parents.english: Honoring parents is one of the greatest obligations in Islam, second only to worship of Allah.
parents.luganda: Okussa abazadde ekitiibwe kimu ku bintu ebikulu mu Siraamu, ekisinga kusinza Allah kyekka.

truthfulness.english: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.
truthfulness.luganda: Okugamba iviri kituuka ku butuukirivu, n'obutuukirivu butuuka ku Ejjanna.

repentance.english: Allah accepts repentance from those who sin out of ignorance and repent soon after.
repentance.luganda: Allah akkiriza okwenenya kuva eri abo abonoona olw'obusiru ne beenenya vuba.
